content:
ada: Quick FYI: planning a small night-drop to publish 1.5.0-rc.locked (py/ts). Goal: push an integration dist-tag and publish deprecation note for the sync client. Rolling in ~30m. objections?
chris: no objections. what's the dist-tag name so CI can pin?
adez: suggest `integration-lock-2026-03-21` to call out the lockfile change.
pat: reminder we need to publish shrinkwrap/lockfile alongside npm tarball so mirror consumers get deterministic installs. Also ensure `npm ci --prefer-offline` tests pass.
ada: good call — I'll include the `npm-shrinkwrap.json` in the package and verify pack order.
deploy-bot: [483400-483401] publish-job queued: py(jb_48340) / npm(nb_48340) :rocket:
ops-bot: security note: key-override requires manual signoff from @irene if signer mismatch.
irene: acknowledged. i'll be online and will approve if needed.
chris: rollback criteria: immediate yank on any `signer-mismatch` or npm 403; revert if runtime 5xx > 0.5% or median SDK latency +250ms in first 10m.
adez: added deprecation copy: "The legacy sync client (`@redwood/sdk-sync`) is deprecated. Migrate to the async/unified client: https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync. Removal scheduled in 90 days"
ada: preflight: 1) changelog updated 2) `deprecated` field set in package.json 3) shrinkwrap included 4) npm pack SHA logged 5) prow pinned to dist-tag for e2e
deploy-bot: [483401-483402] py publish -> testpypi SUCCESS (jb_48340). sha256: 0f1e2d...
pat: starting npm pack+publish with `--tag integration-lock-2026-03-21`
deploy-bot: [483402-483403] npm publish (nb_48340) FAILED: integrity mismatch on tarball. log: `EINTEGRITY: unexpected hash`
chris: ugh. could be nondeterministic pack ordering due to node version or gzip metadata. pat, can you repack with fixed NODE_VERSION=18 and regenerate shrinkwrap?
pat: repacking with node:18 now and regenerating `npm-shrinkwrap.json`. adding explicit `.npmignore` entries to avoid CI noise.
deploy-bot: [483403-483404] npm publish RESTARTED (nb_48340) -> SUCCESS. dist-tag set -> integration-lock-2026-03-21
ops-bot: policy: keep ephemeral dist-tags TTL=24h unless partner asks for extension. auto-clean job scheduled.
adez: running pinned e2e + offline install tests against mirror image. prow is pinned to RC in the webapp tests.
ada: running `npm ci --prefer-offline` now.
deploy-bot: [483404-483405] smoke-suite started (is_48340)
chris: watching metrics: first 5m stable, 0.09% 5xx, median latency +18ms. within rollback thresholds.
irene: no signer issues so far. if anything surfaces I'll approve key fallback.
adez: marketing blurb draft: "Preview: 1.5.0-rc.locked adds lockfile-first packaging and marks legacy sync client deprecated. Partners can test via dist-tag `integration-lock-2026-03-21`. Migration guide linked."
pat: follow-ups: 1) pin node 18 for `pack` job 2) add shrinkwrap checksum assertion step 3) ensure dist-tag auto-clean after 24h 4) ticket to remove deprecated package page after 90d
ada: integration suite PASS. no auth/signature issues.
deploy-bot: [483405-4834013200] smoke-suite COMPLETE: PASS (is_48340).
chris: locking this thread. summary: RC published with shrinkwrap and lockfile, initial integrity fail fixed by node pin, smoke tests green, dist-tag TTL 24h. tag follow-ups captured on release board. :white_check_mark:
